text.p: Champions Panathinaikos returned to the victory trail after three straight defeats on Wednesday, thrashing Sevilla 90-71 in a group G EuroLeague basketball match.

Sevilla, making their debut this season in the top echelon, were no match for the Greeks who scored at will from outside the D (13 out of 20 triples) and also dominated the boards with British forward John Amaechi notching 19 points.
Sevilla's top marksman Michael Anderson scored 18 points but lax defence gave ample space to Panathinaikos playmaker Byron Dinkins to shoot 18 points of his own, including four triples.
Youngster Benito Doblado proved a pleasant surprise for Sevilla, top-scoring with 19 points.
Pananthinaikos top group G after nine wins from 12 games and are now well on course again for the last 16, but Sevilla face an uphill task.
